newsitem.title: CANADA: TVX updates Kassandra mines. [CORRECTED 14:10 GMT]
newsitem.headline: TVX updates Kassandra mines. [CORRECTED 14:10 GMT]

text.p: TVX Gold Inc updated the status of its Kassandra gold mines in Greece on Monday.

At the Madem Lakkos mine, which is currently being mined, a total of 12,102 meters of drilling has been completed, with assays averaging 8.2 percent lead, 13 percent zinc, and 120 grams of silver per tonne of ore, TVX said in a statement.

At the nearby Mavres Petres mine, 3,146 metres of drilling have shown an average of 7.4 percent lead, 9.5 percent zinc, 213 grams per tonne silver and 5.1 grams per tonne gold (Corrects from 5.1 percent gold).
At the Olympias mine, the company continues with its definition drilling, TVX said.
Assays to date show average grades of 5.5 percent lead, 7.7 percent zinc and 10.4 grams per tonne gold.
Exploration drilling at the Skouries deposit at the Kassandra mines has produced assays with average grades of 0.64 percent copper and 1.17 grams per tonne gold, TVX said.
Results from Skouries show the copper-gold porphyry has continuous ore grade mineralization over 800 metres in the central parts of the deposit.
Complete assays should be ready by the end of January, 1997, TVX said.
